notes: Final amendment (Amendment No. 1) reporting results. fund_type: the filing does not call the filer a closed-end fund; it describes a Maryland corporation running repeated tender offers funded by distribution reinvestment plan proceeds, with no listing or ticker, so interval_or_tender_offer_fund is a classification from the filing's description, not a stated fact. price_pct_nav=100: the filing states the price is 'an amount equal to the net asset value per Share' (not written as a percent). Size: the offer was for 'up to the lesser of' (i) 9,859,801 Shares (5% of the WEIGHTED AVERAGE Shares outstanding for calendar 2021, not of shares outstanding at the offer) and (ii) a number set by distribution-reinvestment-plan proceeds; size_shares/size_pct_outstanding carry only cap (i). The binding maximum was evidently cap (ii), since tendered shares exceeded the maximum and 1,136,649 were bought, but the filing does not state cap (ii) as a number. commencement_date is the date of the Offer to Purchase (March 31, 2022), the same day the Schedule TO was filed; the filing does not separately say the offer opened that day. trigger_origin periodic_liquidity is read from the reference to repurchases on each previous repurchase date for tender offers in the period; the filing does not name a programme. Aggregate purchase price approx. $8,304,448.42. No conditions are restated in this amendment.
